title: A no-bid reason code in the reserved exchange-specific range (500+) is a valid, clean no-bid
specNotes: The No-Bid Reason Codes list (OpenRTB 3.0 §List: No-Bid Reason Codes) explicitly reserves 500+ for exchange-specific values, so 700 is a fully valid, spec-legal no-bid reason — this must remain a clean no-bid with no error, no warning, and (unlike its sibling mutation mut-input-shape-nbr-unassigned-code, which uses the unassigned code 42) no code-quality finding at all.

This is the positive control for mut-input-shape-nbr-unassigned-code's missing-capability gap: `expected.response.nbr_code_unassigned` is asserted absent here (mustNot) as a real regression guard — a future range check must not start flagging exchange-specific codes as if they were unassigned ones.
